about.title: About us
about.heading: The story of Quadro
about.p1: Quadro first opened its doors in December 2016 as a European cuisine restaurant. After years in that concept, in 2024 the team reimagined it entirely — giving rise to the modern Spanish house of hospitality you see today.
about.p2: Our kitchen draws on Spanish tradition without being limited by it: local produce, Peruvian-inspired seafood presentation and bold cooking techniques sit alongside simple, honest comfort food.
about.p3: We pay special attention to vegetables, herbs and seasonal produce — part of a philosophy of healthy, honest eating that we share with Spanish culinary tradition.
about.p4: We cook over open flame using the Asador technique, work with local farmers, and choose the freshest seafood for our crudo and light starters.
about.p5: Quadro is a place for gathering in large company — family, friends, colleagues. We believe the best moments happen around a shared table.
